homepage_subtitle: The Ethiopian-Israeli community portal — everything you need, in one place.
homepage_intro: Rights, real estate, professionals, employment, education, health, family, heritage — in Hebrew, English, and Amharic.
pillar_rights_summary: Know what you're entitled to — and actually claim it. Including the community mortgage, klita basket, and urban renewal.
pillar_realestate_summary: Apartments for sale, rent, urban renewal, and government programs — with an eligibility calculator built for the community.
pillar_professionals_summary: Lawyers, financial advisors, real-estate agents and doctors — Amharic-speaking, from within the community, vetted.
pillar_employment_summary: Quality jobs, excellence programs, and scholarships — partnered with Olim Beyahad and Tech-Career.
pillar_education_summary: Scholarships, mechinot, tutoring, and mentors from the community.
pillar_health_summary: Amharic-speaking clinicians, chronic-disease prevention, and mental-health resources — in partnership with Tene Briut.
pillar_family_summary: Help in hard moments, women's empowerment, and senior rights — in all three languages.
pillar_heritage_summary: Sigd, kessim, oral history archive — preserving who we are.
pillar_news_summary: What's happening now — in representation, advocacy, events.
pillar_voice_summary: Report racism and police-conduct issues — secure routing to Tebeka and the right authorities.

mortgage_calc_title: Eligibility check — State mortgage for Ethiopian olim
mortgage_calc_subtitle: A binary check: eligible or not, against the official programme criteria.
mortgage_calc_intro: The official Ministry of Construction & Housing programme grants the same loan amount, term, and rate schedule to every approved family. This calculator only checks whether you meet the criteria — it does not estimate a personal amount, because there isn't one.
mortgage_q_parent_born: One of my parents was born in Ethiopia
mortgage_q_spouse_born: My spouse was born in Ethiopia
mortgage_q_spouse_parent_born: One of my spouse's parents was born in Ethiopia
mortgage_q_child_under_21: I have a child under 21 living with me
mortgage_q_owned_property: I have owned real estate in the past 10 years
mortgage_q_recent_purchase_exception: It was a recent purchase I am still paying for (documented exception)
mortgage_result_eligible_summary: You meet the programme's eligibility criteria. Verify that an active lottery cycle is open before registering.
mortgage_result_ineligible_title: You do not meet the criteria
mortgage_result_ineligible_summary: Below are the reasons we found. Read them and check the official page for full details.
mortgage_eligibility_reason_not_ethiopia: This programme is for applicants born in Ethiopia, or whose parent or spouse was born there.
mortgage_eligibility_reason_not_a_family: This programme is for families (married, common-law, or single-parent with a child under 21).
mortgage_eligibility_reason_single_paren: Single parents qualify only when a child under 21 lives with the applicant.
mortgage_eligibility_reason_owned_proper: The programme requires no real-estate ownership in the past 10 years (exceptions apply).
mortgage_process_step_register: Register at a participating bank branch (₪70 fee) to obtain an eligibility certificate.
mortgage_process_step_certificate: Submit the eligibility certificate together with origin documentation.
mortgage_process_step_lottery: Annual lottery — about 200 families are drawn from the eligible pool.
mortgage_process_step_window: Use the loan within 4 months of the draw, up to 99% of the property price.
mortgage_lead_cta_description: Leave your details — we'll connect you with a community-vetted mortgage advisor.
mortgage_govil_link_label: Programme page on the Ministry of Construction & Housing site
mortgage_disclaimer_active_lottery: Lottery cycles are announced periodically on the Ministry of Construction & Housing site. Verify that an active cycle is open before registering.
